templates.name: C1 AI Agents & Workflow Automation · Step 1 (Day 1)
subjects: {{first_name}}, what if 40% of tickets handled themselves?
templates.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Most {{industry}} teams I speak with have the same story: support tickets, invoices and onboarding steps still bounce between inboxes, spreadsheets and five different SaaS tools.

We build AI agents that sit inside those workflows. They read the ticket or document, decide the next step, update Salesforce/SAP/Zendesk and only escalate to a human when needed. Our Flozic platform connects to 1,000+ apps, and our engineering team handles the enterprise integration, security and rollout.
templates.cta: Worth a 20-minute call to map two or three workflows at {{company}} we could automate first?

templates.name: C1 AI Agents & Workflow Automation · Step 2 (Day 3)
subjects: {{first_name}} — pilot scope, not a sales deck
templates.body:

• Weeks 5–6: run live, measure hours saved and accuracy

Fixed scope, fixed price, and you keep the workflows whether or not you continue with us.

templates.name: C2 AI-Accelerated Legacy Modernization · Step 1 (Day 1)
subjects: {{first_name}}, a faster path off legacy systems
Legacy rewrite in months, not years
templates.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Many {{industry}} companies still run critical work on systems written 15–25 years ago: .NET Framework, Oracle Forms, COBOL or old on-premise portals. The people who know them are retiring, and every change is slow and risky.

Our engineering team uses AI to read and document the legacy code, generate tests that lock in current behaviour, and rebuild it as modern cloud, web and mobile apps. The result is typically a much shorter timeline and lower cost than a traditional rewrite, with no big-bang cutover.
templates.cta: Open to a short call about which system at {{company}} is the biggest headache today?

templates.name: C2 AI-Accelerated Legacy Modernization · Step 2 (Day 3)
templates.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

To make this low-risk, we offer a two-week modernization assessment on one application:

• AI-generated documentation of the current code and data flows
• A target architecture (cloud, API, web and mobile)
• A phased migration plan with a fixed-price estimate

You keep the documentation and plan whatever you decide.
templates.cta: Which application would you want assessed first?

templates.name: C2 AI-Accelerated Legacy Modernization · Step 3 (Day 7)
subjects: How we avoid the risky 'big bang'
templates.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

The usual fear with modernization is a long project and a risky cutover. We avoid that by replacing the system piece by piece: new modules run alongside the old ones behind the same APIs, and traffic moves over gradually with automated regression tests at every step.

Your users keep working, and you see a working release within the first few weeks.
templates.cta: Would a one-page example plan for a system like yours be useful?

templates.name: C2 AI-Accelerated Legacy Modernization · Step 4 (Day 14)
templates.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

This is my last note on this. If modernization isn't on {{company}}'s roadmap this year, just let me know and I'll step back.

If it is, the free two-week assessment is still open.
templates.cta: Reply 'assessment' and I'll send the scope.

templates.name: C3 Enterprise Data & Knowledge AI (RAG) · Step 1 (Day 1)
subjects: An AI assistant that knows {{company}}'s documents
{{first_name}}, where does your team's knowledge live?
templates.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Most {{industry}} companies have thousands of policies, contracts, manuals and reports spread across SharePoint, drives and email, and staff spend hours searching for answers that already exist.

We build private AI assistants on top of that knowledge. They answer questions with citations to the source document, respect existing access permissions, and run in your own cloud if required. We also build the data pipelines that keep everything current.
templates.cta: Would a 20-minute call to look at one knowledge area at {{company}} be worthwhile?

templates.name: C3 Enterprise Data & Knowledge AI (RAG) · Step 2 (Day 3)
subjects: What a 4-week knowledge AI pilot includes
templates.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

A quick outline of our pilot:

• Pick one document set (e.g. policies, contracts, SOPs or product manuals)
• Build a secure assistant with source citations and role-based access
• Test with 20–50 real users and measure time saved and answer accuracy

It deploys in your cloud tenancy, and your data is never used to train public models.
templates.cta: Shall I send a short proposal for {{company}}?

templates.name: C3 Enterprise Data & Knowledge AI (RAG) · Step 3 (Day 7)
templates.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Most stalled enterprise AI projects share one cause: messy, duplicated or inaccessible data. That's why our projects start with data readiness: cleaning, structuring and connecting the sources before any model is involved.

It's the difference between a demo that impresses and a system people actually use every day.

templates.name: C4 AI Governance, Security & Compliance · Step 1 (Day 1)
subjects: {{first_name}}, do you know every AI tool in use at {{company}}?
AI governance without slowing teams down
templates.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

With EU AI Act obligations phasing in and regulators asking harder questions, many {{industry}} companies are discovering AI tools in use that nobody formally approved.

We help risk and compliance teams get in control: an inventory of AI systems, risk classification, testing of chatbots and models for data leakage and harmful outputs, and practical controls such as PII redaction, logging and private model hosting.
templates.cta: Would a short call on where {{company}} stands today be helpful?

templates.name: C4 AI Governance, Security & Compliance · Step 2 (Day 3)
templates.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Our AI risk assessment runs about three weeks and delivers:

• An inventory of AI systems and shadow-AI usage
• A risk classification mapped to the EU AI Act and ISO 42001
• Security testing of your highest-risk AI use cases
• A prioritised remediation roadmap your board can read

Fixed fee, clear deliverables.
templates.cta: Shall I send the full scope?

templates.name: C4 AI Governance, Security & Compliance · Step 3 (Day 7)
templates.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Three questions we hear auditors ask most often:

1. Which AI systems do you run, and who owns each one?
2. How do you stop personal or confidential data reaching external models?
3. How do you test and monitor outputs over time?

If any of those would be hard to answer at {{company}} today, we can help close the gap quickly.
templates.cta: Is this something your team is working on now?

templates.name: C4 AI Governance, Security & Compliance · Step 4 (Day 14)
templates.body:

My last note. If AI governance is already covered at {{company}}, that's great to hear. Just reply and I'll close this out.

If it's still open, the three-week assessment is available.
templates.cta: Thanks for your time, {{first_name}}.
